name: University of Tübingen Zentrum für Datenverarbeitung (ZDV)
notes: University page identifies ZDV as the university's computing/data center serving students, faculties, and central institutions, with address at Wächterstraße 76, Tübingen.

name: Dr.-Ing. Nepustil & Co. GmbH Rechenzentrum Tübingen
notes: Operator imprint lists Rechenzentrum Tübingen at Brückenstraße 7, 72074 Tübingen; project page references remote-backup tape-library housing in the Tübingen data center.

name: SWU Rechenzentrum II, Ulm Science Park III
developer: Stadtwerke Ulm/Neu-Ulm GmbH / SWU TeleNet; built by DC-Datacenter-Group
notes: City of Ulm reported key handover on 2025-03-27 after about two years of construction; SWU source said the Science Park III build would provide space for about 150 server cabinets. DCD reported 1,430 sqm, PUE below 1.3, and 1.6 MW backup generation.

name: weber.cloud Data Center Balingen 1
notes: Operator page says weber.cloud owns and operates its own data center in the same building as its headquarters in Balingen, Zollernalbkreis; PeeringDB lists the Balingen facility at Bahnhofstr. 16.

name: weber.cloud Data Center Balingen 2 (BL2)
notes: Operator page stated a second weber.cloud data center in Balingen (BL2) was to be created; Data Center Map also notes a second facility being built at Zollernstr. 47-49, Balingen.

name: za-internet Datacenter Hechingen
notes: Operator page states za-internet operates a provider-independent datacenter in Hechingen with rackspace for customer servers and multiple upstream providers.

name: GBC local data center Balingen/Albstadt
notes: Company page says GBC has operated critical systems since 1987 with its own local data center in Balingen/Albstadt for SMEs and public-sector institutions.

name: Aichach-Friedberg district school data center migration
notes: Regional press report described a data center for district schools, with Realschule Mering and Gymnasium Friedberg still to be migrated by mid-2026; public snippet available, full article may require subscription.

name: OTH Amberg-Weiden Rechenzentrum, Amberg campus
notes: University page identifies the OTH Amberg-Weiden computing center as IT service provider and IT competence center for university operations, supplying modern efficient IT infrastructure.

name: Dietenhofen Playmobil-site data center redevelopment proposal
notes: Regional reports say a company/investor wants to build a data center east of Neustädter Straße on the Playmobil complex in Dietenhofen, with demolition of the high-bay warehouse and PV system; planning and permitting had begun. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Bezirk Mittelfranken interim data center, Ansbach
notes: Regional report sourced to Bezirk Mittelfranken said the Liegenschaftsausschuss would consider an interim data center at the Ansbach district administration site, using a special outdoor IT container because the existing Danziger Straße 7 data center had reached capacity limits.
